message: ごめんね

name: Synn
message: 「Hustle, hustle, hustle!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Bustle, bustle!」

name: Misa
message: 「Scramble, scramble... Hey, argh! What are you two thinking, doing this so early in the morning!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Misa
message: 「Just look! It's so early that Paqy is still fast asleep.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're one to talk, Misa. Heading to school at this crack of dawn, we won't just be the first ones in the classroom--we'll be the first ones at the entire academy!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nngh...!」
In the early morning just as the mist has cleared, the three of us make our way toward the academy.
Moving past a brisk walk, we're practically racing.

name: Synn
message: 「You're up as early as a milkman. No wonder we couldn't run into you on our usual commute, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「When I leave my house is entirely my own business! Don't go out of your way to ambush me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Feels like it's been forever since the three of us walked to the academy together. Well, even though we were together just four days ago.」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez! Nanaka!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Taha, tahahaha~」
The early morning air is crisp and refreshing. I slow my pace just a little.
Bathed in the morning sun, Misa's twintails and Nanaka's ponytail bounce cheerfully. I'm having fun too. I want to keep watching the two of them like this.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Goal!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm first place too!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yep, it's a tie between Misa and Nanaka this morning.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll award the two of you a special prize for tying for first. Like milk, or milk, or maybe milk!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let's do this, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, I'm right with you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow-ow-ow! Y-You two didn't have to slap my back at the exact same time! Milk is good for you, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm not mad about that! Synn, you held back when we walked this morning, didn'tcha!?」

name: Misa
message: 「That's right, that's right! A match like this doesn't count!!」
The school gate where nobody has arrived yet. Letting our lively chatter echo down the tree-lined path, we head toward the entrance.

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister! The apparition is over here, please make haste!」
Alerted by Shio-chan's report, we rushed over to the new school building.
The Crusaders' after-school patrol. Today we split into two groups again, with Misa, Nanaka, and me teaming up.

name: Synn
message: 「This is a tricky spot. There are plenty of places to hide. We need to find the demon before nightfall.」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Shut up! I'm not scared of the school building at night at all, you know!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn didn't even say anything like that, y'know? Misa, could it be you're bad with dark places?」

name: Misa
message: 「G-Gulp!!」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm sleepy~, and hungry. I'm gonna go take a break over there, okay.」

name: Sally
message: 「Hogyaaa!? I-It's hereee, it's a demonnn.」

name: Shio
message: 「Lurking inside the school building--this demon undoubtedly intends to commit indecent acts against the young ladies. Let us teach it a lesson!」
